repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The JoI condition checks for a volume increase (v2 - v1 >= 20) while the IR requires a decrease (v1 - v2 >= 20). With input volume jumping from 0 to 20, the JoI incorrectly triggered the action.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction operands in the if condition from v2 - v1 to v1 - v2 to match the IR specification.
